title: Chapter 2727: The Eternal’s Name
content:
Chapter 2727: The Eternal’s Name

While everyone around him cried in despair, Yuan quietly returned to Mei Feng, who stood frozen like a statue, staring at the sky with a perplexed expression.

As Yuan approached, Mei Feng asked in a low but clear voice without shifting her gaze from the sky, "Do you think you’ll be able to defeat all of them?"

"...By yourself," she added a split second later.

Yuan stood beside her and looked up at the sky as well.

"Sorry, but I cannot make any promises."

Although he was confident he could defeat all the invaders himself, he wasn’t sure he could handle the Eternal behind them.

Mei Feng shook her head and replied in a soft voice, "No, you don’t have anything to apologize for. If anything, I... this world should be apologizing to you for making you bear the responsibility of saving humanity."

"If all of the invaders are on the same level as the ones I’ve already defeated, I can certainly defeat all of them with ease. Unfortunately, the issue lies with their master—the Eternal that is commanding them."

"That bald head that’s larger than our entire world, huh?" Mei Feng sighed.

After a brief moment of silence, she said, "If I had known this was how our lives and this world would end, I wouldn’t have joined the military and just spent the rest of my life as a civilian and enjoyed life as an ordinary individual. I haven’t even gotten to experience love yet. What a pity."

Yuan raised an eyebrow at her words and turned to look at her, puzzled.

"That’s not something I’d expect to hear from a mother."

Mei Feng smiled and said, "Just because I have a daughter doesn’t mean I’ve experienced love."

"Arranged marriage, huh?" Yuan muttered.

"What are you talking about?" Mei Feng finally stopped looking at the sky and turned to face him.

"I’m not married, nor have I ever been."

"Huh? Then what about the father?"

"He doesn’t exist, either."

Yuan’s eyes widened.

"Are you telling me that Mei Xiaoyun was adopted?"

"No, she definitely came from my womb."

"Then how...?"

"Since you’re from another world, you probably don’t know this, but we have technology that allows women to give birth without needing a man. Xiaoyun was created entirely from my genes. It wouldn’t be wrong to call her a clone of me, though that isn’t entirely accurate either, since there are still some differences between us," she revealed, dropping a shocking bombshell.

Yuan’s jaw dropped at her words.

"W-Why?"

"Because we’re short on people. Our population has been declining for decades, and with the Void Specters growing stronger over time, the situation has only gotten worse. That said, we’re not required to do it. It’s all optional."

"Can I ask why you decided to do it?"

"I ask myself that question all the time, and even now, I still wonder why I did such a thing. Honestly, it doesn’t matter anymore, and it’s not like I regret it."

"Does Mei Xiaoyun know this?"

"Of course. I have no reason to keep it a secret from her, and she would’ve found out herself eventually."

Since it was common, even normal, in their world, keeping it a secret would do more harm than good.

After a moment of silence, Mei Feng spoke, "Hey, want to be my lover?"

"What?" Yuan’s eyes widened at her question.

"Or would you rather be with my daughter?"

"..."

Yuan was speechless.

But when Yuan finally opened his mouth to speak, Mei Feng interrupted, "I’m joking. Let’s return to our city now."

Mei Feng turned to the teleporter, but the operator was nowhere to be seen.

Mei Feng shook her head and operated the teleporter herself, entering a direct teleportation code for Gaia’s Heaven so they could return without requiring approval, since no one was there to operate the other side.

Once they returned to Gaia’s Heaven, they went to the Parade Deck, and sure enough, everyone was still there, most of them staring at the sky with despair in their eyes.

"It hasn’t even been ten minutes since you left. How did it go with the other invaders? Did you manage to save any of the other cities?" Supreme General Tian asked, already expecting the worst because of how quickly they’d returned.

Mei Feng then said, "Although I don’t know the condition of each city due to how fast we traveled between each city, Yuan took care of the remaining invaders."

"They should be fine," said Yuan. "Eastern Dawn had the worst damage, but their people are safe because the invader had gathered all of them in one place without harming them."

"What’s the plan now?" Yuan then asked.

"..."

Supreme General Tian fell silent.

He slowly turned his gaze to the sky, where thousands of invaders gathered just outside the barrier.

"There’s even more of them now..." he sighed.

"Unfortunately, I don’t know what we can do—if there’s even anything we can do about this situation. Unless you are able to defeat all of the invaders by yourself, humanity and this world are doomed."

"I’ll do what I can, but I won’t make any promises."

Supreme General Tian wore a bitter expression as he realized that he was placing the weight of the entire world on Yuan’s shoulders alone.

"Yuan."

A familiar voice suddenly called out.

When Yuan turned, he saw Yu Rou standing not too far away, wearing a black veil.

"I need a moment of your time."

Yuan nodded and followed Yu Rou to a quieter place.

"What’s up?" Yuan asked when Yu Rou finally stopped.

She turned around to face him and said, "It has spoken to me."

Yuan raised an eyebrow.

"The Eternal behind you?"

She nodded.

"And I asked for its name."

"Did it tell you?"

"..."

Yu Rou remained silent for a few seconds before slowly nodding her head.

"Oh?" Yuan muttered, sounding pleasantly surprised.

"What is their name?"

Yu Rou took a deep breath through her nose before opening her mouth, "Its name is—"
